headline: Pankaj Bajaj files Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure with NSE for Eldeco Housing and Industries
sum: Pankaj Bajaj has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) with the NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Eldeco Housing and Industries Limited, signalling a material shareholding event or change in control position.
detail: Pankaj Bajaj has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This regulation mandates that any person who acquires shares resulting in substantial shareholding (crossing 25% or achieving control) must disclose within two trading days. The filing with NSE creates a public record and potential trigger for an open offer under Regulation 37, unless an exemption (e.g., creeping acquisition, restructuring) applies. The exact shareholding percentage, acquisition method, and any open offer obligation remain to be confirmed from the full disclosure document.
